title: 🌐 Online: Movies Hard #2
desc: Trivia from OpenTrivia DB — 10 hard questions

questions.q: In the 1964 film "Zulu", what song does the British Army company sing before the final battle?
In the movie "Scream" who is Ghost Face?
In the "Jurassic Park" universe, when did "Jurassic Park: San Diego" begin construction?
What three movies, in order from release date, make up the "Dollars Trilogy"?
questions.a: "A Fistful of Dollars", "For a Few Dollars More", "The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly"

questions.q: In the "Jurassic Park" universe, what was the first dinosaur cloned by InGen in 1986?
Which actors made up the trio in "The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly"?
questions.a: Clint Eastwood, Eli Wallach, and Lee Van Cleef

questions.q: In order to cut costs, what were most of the extras of Mad Max (1979) paid with?
Which actress portrayed Dr. Grace Augustine in the James Cameron movie "Avatar"?
In "Star Trek Nemesis", why was Praetor Shinzon created?
questions.a: To replace Picard as a Romulan Agent

questions.q: The film Mad Max: Fury Road features the Dies Irae from which composer's requiem?
